newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Plane diverted for man who vomited cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Plane diverted for man who vomited cocaine.

text.p: A passenger whose illness forced the diversion of his New York-bound flight to Ireland vomited 21 packets of cocaine and told police he had more in his stomach.
Police said on Tuesday that the 19-year-old Jamaican was under guard at a hospital near Ennis after falling ill on an American Airlines flight from London to New York.
He had apparently flow from Kingston, Jamaica, to London last week but was refused entry by Britain, tested for drugs and then put on a flight back to Jamaica.

But he fell ill over the Atlantic. Cabin crew thought he was suffering an epileptic fit and the plane was diverted to Ireland's Shannon airport. The man was appparently serving as a "mule" - a term used in the narcotics underworld for couriers who ferry drugs across borders.
